body: Your free trial has ended. You were not charged.
On Free you keep unlimited screening analyses, the Deal score, and up to 5 saved deals.

body.text: The annual offer, 50% off your first year, is still open until {{offer_ends}}. It is applied at checkout when you choose Pro annual.
Pro adds the Offer Ceiling, downside testing, comparisons, and reports on every deal.
